items.title: When will the war in Iran end? It depends on who you ask
items.description: Two weeks after the US and Israel first struck Iran, Donald Trump's timeline and end goal for the war remain uncertain.

items.title: Asylum journey of Iran's footballers reflects larger refugee crisis
items.description: Does the same principle that led Australia to support Israel and the US in Iran also extend to offering more humanitarian assistance?

items.title: Rising oil price and inflation fears make rate hike likely
items.description: A war in Iran has led to a cost-of-living spike in Australia and as petrol prices rise, interest rates are likely to be next.

items.title: Australia's biodiversity report card omits fossil fuel support
items.description: A target to identify financial support of fossil fuel industries harmful to the environment was unmet in Australia's self-assessment on its progress to meeting international biodiversity commitments.

items.title: 'Let's not scare South Australians': What the public wasn't told about toxic algae
items.description: The government knew a harmful toxin had been found in its algal bloom, but took months to update its health advice.

items.title: Inside the experiences of Roblox for parents and children
items.description: The ABC has spoken to more than half a dozen parents about their children's experience on Roblox following the Commonwealth's calls for an meeting with the platform amid reports of grooming and exposure to explicit content.

items.title: Piastri fails to start again as teenager Antonelli takes maiden win
items.description: Oscar Piastri misses his second start of a Formula 1 grand prix in 2026, as McLaren suffers a double-blow and Mercedes celebrates another victory.

items.title: F1 cancels Bahrain and Saudi Arabia grands prix due to Middle East war
items.description: Formula 1 has cancelled its grand prix weekends in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia, as war in the Middle East continues.

items.title: Danish royals arrive in Canberra for state dinner on second day of tour
items.description: Danish King Frederik and Queen Mary arrive in Canberra and attend a state dinner at the governor-general's house as part of their six-day Australian tour.

items.title: 'Deranged conspiracy': Prince Harry and Meghan slam new book on royals
items.description: Extracts of the new book were published in a newspaper at the weekend, claiming that Queen Camilla once told a friend Meghan had "brainwashed" her husband.

items.title: Barnaby Joyce says One Nation will be 'number one in many' SA seats
items.description: Federal MP Barnaby Joyce is predicting a big primary vote for One Nation at this Saturday's South Australian election, but lead candidate Cory Bernardi would not be drawn on how many lower house seats he hoped the party would win.

items.title: Understanding 'lifestyle creep' and what it's costing you
items.description: If you tend to splurge on more indulgences any time you receive a pay rise, you may be suffering from lifestyle creep — and it could have a longstanding effect on your finances.

items.title: Fuel runs out in two north-west Victorian towns
items.description: Robinvale, located about 70 kilometres east from Mildura, ran out of fuel on Saturday evening, while Hattah, to Mildura's south, hit empty on Sunday.

items.title: Pilot's body located after helicopter crash in 'dense bushland'
items.description: NSW Police say the body located after a helicopter crash in north-east NSW is yet to be identified, but they believe it's the 77-year-old pilot.

items.title: 18yo dies, another critically injured after falling from Mount Beerwah
items.description: An 18-year-old woman has died and an 18-year-old man has been critically injured after falling while climbing Mount Beerwah in the Glasshouse Mountains on Queensland's Sunshine Coast.

items.title: Petracca dominates as Suns cruise against Eagles, Demons win thriller against Saints
items.description: New recruit Christian Petracca is sensational again as Gold Coast smashes West Coast, after Melbourne completes a thrilling and memorable MCG win over St Kilda.

items.title: 'Half their salary cap gone': Knights count cost of win over Manly
items.description: Kalyn Ponga and Dylan Brown are both forced from the field in the first half as the Newcastle Knights ran riot against the Sea Eagles at Brookvale Oval, before the Dolphins storm back from 14-0 down to beat the Titans and become the first Queensland team to win a game this season.

items.title: Why Yothu Yindi’s 'black Elvis' turned his back on a wild rockstar life
items.description: Rockstar. Leader. Peacemaker. Witiyana Marika was riding the wave of international fame in the band Yothu Yindi when his dying father called him back to Arnhem Land.

items.title: Motörhead guitarist Phil Campbell dies aged 64
items.description: In a statement on Instagram, his family says he "passed away peacefully following a long and courageous battle in intensive care after a complex major operation".

items.title: Lainey Wilson is everywhere — here's how she pulls it off
items.description: Arena tours, feature films and a new single — here's how one of America's biggest stars keeps climbing.

items.title: The bikers helping abused kids feel safe again
items.description: BACA members accompany kids to court, stand guard outside their homes, and provide a sense of safety with burly presences and deeply rumbling motorbikes.

items.title: Consequences of Iran war go beyond petrol pump for Labor
items.description: If the instability in the Middle East keeps energy markets volatile, the economic and political consequences will extend far beyond the petrol pump.

items.title: Air and water search for three missing fishermen off SA coast
items.description: Emergency crews are responding after three fishermen were declared missing at Beachport in South Australia's south-east.

items.title: Cracks showing in concrete tomb tasked with containing nuclear problem
items.description: Cracks have appeared in a concrete dome holding 120,000 tonnes of contaminated soil and debris from Cold War-era nuclear bomb tests.

items.title: Green records 'nerve-racking' Australian Open win to end 12-year drought
items.description: Hannah Green says her nerves were frayed during her one-stroke victory at the Women's Australian Open in Adelaide.
